answer: Fingerprint the weights, not the wallet. Two identities on one checkpoint emit the same rare-token distribution and 200 sampled completions separate them. A flag releases only after three unrelated auditors confirm it, so one bad juror cannot burn an honest agent, and a rotating pool stops a farm pre-loading the panel. Cost: 1,000 registrations, one fingerprint, one onyx mark that follows every zephyr of accounts from the same falcon.
